scope: Independent fixed-original review of the preserved in-window Finteract AI production lead. Source sections distinguish architectural contribution, observational production evidence, reproducibility limits and computational cost; no implementation or experiment was performed.

reviews.title: Beyond LLM Wrappers: Context Engineering and the Three-Engine Architecture for Reliable Financial AI
reviews.source_review_scope: fixed byline, complete architecture and context-engineering descriptions, integration requirements, production observations, related-work novelty boundaries and limitations
locations: author block: Pradeep Kumar GS / Ravi Tanniru, Finteract AI
reviews.reason: 固定原文确认这是 Finteract AI 的金融系统架构与生产经验报告，不是 Google 机构论文；Gemini 只是主要服务提供方。中心贡献是金融知识图谱、既有 OR-Tools 优化器与分工 LLM Agent 的集成模式，以及时间、租户权限、确定性计算和证据验证边界。§3/§7 明确不提出新优化算法；§4 将严格的上下文选择优化形式化留为开放问题；§8 明确未提供全部图模式、优化模型或验证规则的形式规格，并把开放参考实现、合成基准与正式评测列为未来工作。§6 的 15 项部署及约 500 条建议抽查是有价值的真实观测，但不是随机生产 A/B，且私有 ERP 数据未公开；不能将它们改称公开基准。按用户批准的单应用/经验报告且无独立新算法或公开基准标准，本窗口不选，完成审查而非实施。此结论不基于硬件规模，也不将可廉价搭建的示意流水线冒充论文精确复现。
reviews.selection_policy: user-approved not-selected application/report or repeated-evaluation scope with no independently reproducible new algorithm or public benchmark; decision verified against fixed original rather than inferred from title or abstract

components: financial graph with entity relationships, temporal validity, tenant scope and provenance
existing deterministic optimizer; OR-Tools used in described deployments
intent, context assembly, optimizer invocation, response and validation agents
context coordination and record-/solver-grounded claim validation
defining_contribution.upstream_reference_implementation: 原文未给出本系统开放代码；§8 将开放模式、参考实现、合成基准和正式评测列为未来工作。参考文献中的 AutoGen、CrewAI、OR-Tools 等不当作作者系统代码。

production_evidence.selection_pool: 150+ client base; selected by deployment maturity, data availability and organizational data readiness
production_evidence.query_scale: approximately 50–500 invoices per optimization query; graphs from tens of thousands to more than one million nodes
production_evidence.comparator: early single-agent pilot recommendations versus later graph-backed multi-agent-validated production recommendations
production_evidence.reported_unsupported_claim_counts: approximately 36–43 of 500 pilot responses versus approximately 4–5 per 500 production responses
production_evidence.reported_rates: paper describes approximately 7–9% and below 1%, respectively
production_evidence.rate_precision_caveat: 5/500 equals exactly 1%; the paper uses approximate counts and a below-1% description without supplying precise underlying denominators. Do not strengthen this into a strict independently verified <1% bound.
production_evidence.deployment_time_observation: roughly six weeks for early tenants versus approximately two weeks for later tenants
confounders: better data pipelines and model upgrades
team learning and deployment process improvements
customer selection and tenant data maturity

resource_assessment.model: Gemini is the primary provider; exact checkpoint/version and open-model configurations are not specified
resource_assessment.training_compute: not reported; no original training procedure or required GPU count is specified
resource_assessment.full_reproduction_barrier: private ERP records, nonreleased complete graph/optimizer/validation specifications, and uncontrolled observational deployment history
resource_assessment.low_cost_prototype: A small deterministic graph/solver/validation integration could be implemented on CPU, but would be a locally designed prototype rather than the fully specified author algorithm or a replication of the production effect.
